title: AI News and Agentic AI - Test Exam
description: 20 questions: AI news from November 2026, basic agentic AI concepts, and related tech ideas.

items.text: On 17 November 2026, OpenAI released two new GPT-6.2 models. Which pair?
options: GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol
GPT-6.2 Hydrogen and GPT-6.2 Carbon
GPT-6.2 Fable and GPT-6.2 Mythos
GPT-6.2 Argon and GPT-6.2 Neon

items.text: Which company released the Gemini 4 Neon model on 18 November 2026?
options: OpenAI
Google
Anthropic
Microsoft

items.text: Google placed Gemini 4 Neon between which two models in its Gemini 4 line-up?
options: Argon and Krypton
Nano and Ultra
Hydrogen and Carbon
Flash and Pro

items.text: Which model did OpenAI describe as its first released model to meet the 'High' threshold for AI self-improvement?
options: GPT-6.2 Sol
GPT-6.2 Astra
GPT-6 Cyber
GPT-Image 2.6

items.text: What made Anthropic's November 2026 IPO notable?
options: It was cancelled after one day
It was the first AI IPO priced under $10 a share
It was limited to Anthropic employees only
It raised about $81.3 billion and was the largest IPO on record

items.text: Perplexity's new Monitor API is designed to do what?
options: Watch web pages or searches and notify an agent only when something changes
Generate images from text prompts
Train a new model on private data
Translate phone calls in real time

items.text: Workday completed its acquisition of C1.ai. What does C1.ai help govern?
options: GPU supply for data centres
Social media advertising
Identity and access for both people and AI agents
Consumer phone plans

items.text: Anthropic began a beta rollout of computer use for Claude Team and Enterprise. What does it let Claude do?
options: Replace the operating system on the user's computer
See the user's screen and work inside allowed desktop apps
Control industrial robots without permission
Run entirely without any user account

items.text: Which description best fits an AI agent?
options: A model that only answers one question at a time
A database that stores training data
A website that lists AI news
A system that can plan and take actions with tools to reach a goal

items.text: What is the usual order of steps in an agentic loop?
options: Observe, delete memory, finish, plan
Train, deploy, forget, restart
Plan or reason, act with a tool, observe the result, repeat or finish
Generate an image, publish, log out

items.text: What is a tool call in an agentic system?
options: The agent requests an external function or API to get data or perform an action
The user types a password into the chat
The model stores its weights on disk
The browser refreshes the page

items.text: What does the ReAct pattern combine?
options: Random sampling with gradient descent
Reasoning steps with actions and observations
Image generation with speech recognition
Database indexing with encryption

items.text: What is human-in-the-loop in an agent workflow?
options: A human writes every token by hand
The agent runs only when no one is watching
A loop that never ends
A person reviews or approves the agent at defined checkpoints

items.text: What problem does the Model Context Protocol (MCP) mainly solve?
options: A way to compress images for the web
A standard for charging electric cars
A common way for AI apps to connect to external tools and data sources
A protocol for printing documents

items.text: What does least-privilege access mean for an AI agent?
options: Give it every permission so it never gets stuck
Give it only the permissions and data it needs for the task
Remove all logging so it runs faster
Let it create its own administrator account

items.text: In a multi-agent system, what is orchestration?
options: A coordinator assigns tasks to specialised agents and combines their results
One agent answers every question without tools
A method for reducing screen brightness
A way to store files in a spreadsheet

items.text: How does retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improve an answer?
options: It trains a new model for every question
It guesses the answer without any sources
It retrieves relevant documents or data and includes them as context before generating
It only uses the model's smallest weights

items.text: What is prompt injection?
options: A way to speed up model training with extra GPUs
A technique for compressing prompts to save disk space
A method for injecting JavaScript into a PDF
Hidden or malicious instructions in content that try to make the model follow the attacker instead of the user

items.text: What is a vector database mainly used for?
options: Rendering 3D game graphics
Storing embeddings and finding semantically similar items
Sending email newsletters
Managing spreadsheet formulas

items.text: What is a model's context window?
options: The maximum amount of text or tokens it can consider in one request
The time limit for downloading the model
The number of users allowed to sign in
The size of the model's screen
